concepts.gloss_en: God as 'the place of the world' — the classic epithet that He is the place of the world, the world is not His place

members.note: bare fixed rabbinic epithet for the Divine as place of the world

same epithet with subject copula 'הוא' ('He is the place of the world'); the added pronoun is predication, not a distinct construct head — same referent (God). Different Torah context (lm2:1 Beit HaMikdash vs lm2:83 Shabbat) but the epithet is identical

notes: Merged as one concept: both name God as 'the place of the world.' 'הוא' is a copula subject, not a distinct construct head, so rule 4 does not force a split. Kept at 'likely' rather than 'obvious' because the second usage's immediate proof context (Shabbat/tachlit) does not display the phrase in situ.
